### full gate
$ node dist/cli.js gate full.inlined.html --tokens tokens.json
gate: full.inlined.html — 0 error(s), 0 warning(s)
  layout: clean
  a11y: clean
  taste: clean
  tell: clean
  content: clean
  autofix: clean
exit=0

### raw gate
$ node dist/cli.js gate raw.html --tokens tokens.json
gate: raw.html — 1 error(s), 0 warning(s)
    ✗ [raw-hex-when-token-exists] inline color #000 is not a design-system token
exit=1
